cards.name: YES Bank World Select

cards.name: YES BANK RuPay Credit Card
cards.notes: Lifetime-free virtual RuPay card. 4 YES Rewardz/₹200 on qualifying merchant UPI transactions only when the individual UPI transaction is above ₹2,000; modeled at up to ₹0.25/point = 0.5%. Other non-UPI spend: 2 YES Rewardz/₹200 = up to 0.25%. UPI rewards capped at 5,000 points/month. Utility rewards capped at 150 points/statement cycle. P2P UPI is not allowed.

cards.name: HSBC Live+
cards.notes: 10% accelerated cashback up to ₹1,200/month across eligible dining, food delivery, grocery, shopping and utility spends; 1.5% on most other eligible spends.

cards.name: Amazon Pay ICICI
cards.notes: Assumes Amazon Prime member for 5% Amazon cashback. Non-Prime rate differs.

cards.name: CASHBACK SBI Card
cards.notes: From 1 Apr 2026: 5% online capped at ₹2,000/statement cycle and 1% offline capped at ₹2,000; several categories excluded.
